ev_none: No ATHENA event about {c} right now.
heads_none: No headlines from newsrooms based in {c} in the last 48 hours.
heads_note: Headlines as published, often in the local language · each opens the original article.
sources: ATHENA follows {n} working newsroom(s) based in {c}.
thin: {c} has fewer than two working newsrooms in ATHENA, so its local stories cannot become ATHENA events yet - you mostly see international stories that mention it.
notfound: No country found with that name - try its English name.

desk.risk_none: No high-risk event about the country now.
desk.brief_x: Local stories carried by two or more of the country's own newsrooms, most widely reported first.
desk.topics_h: What the country's newsrooms are writing about
desk.nr_x: The most visited news sites of the country, rated by kind and reach.
desk.tr_off: Translation is being set up: headlines are shown in their original language.
desk.rise_x: Stories that several of the country's newsrooms started reporting in the last hours. Most are found in machine-translated headlines, so each is shown only after a double check: independent newsrooms, the same story in their original headlines (or the same facts in separate translations), and the shown translation checked. Not ATHENA's verification: an ATHENA event is linked when there is one.
desk.chk_orig: same story in the original headlines
desk.chk_rt: translation checked back against the original
desk.chk_2nd: confirmed by a second, separate translation
desk.tr_poor: The machine translation of this headline was not reliable, so the original is shown.
desk.mr_x: The stories carried by the most of {c}'s own newsrooms in the last 48 hours, ranked by how many carry them.
